summary: Learn CCUS technologies, storage screening, and MRV planning through practical exercises. Build project-ready outputs in 5 days.
lede: Carbon capture training covers how to assess carbon capture, utilization and storage options and build a practical project case. For energy, industrial and infrastructure professionals, it develops skills in comparing capture technologies and utilization routes, estimating preliminary storage capacity, mapping project risks, and organizing emissions and monitoring evidence for a feasibility brief.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to make CCUS decisions in real industrial, energy, and infrastructure settings.
prerequisites: You should have basic familiarity with industrial decarbonization, emissions management, or project evaluation. Please bring a laptop with spreadsheet software for calculations and template-based exercises; no programming is required, and all core tools can be used at operational application level.
